articles.title: pnpr 0.1.0-alpha.16
articles.summary: pnpr 0.1.0-alpha.16 serves every ecosystem under its own URL prefix, moves hosted storage to a new layout upgraded with pnpr upgrade-storage , and replaces artifacts.compilerCaches and pipeline.workspaces with artifacts.orgs . It also adds tar registries, zstd metadata and tarball compression, npm audit and provenance endpoints, Prometheus metrics, and pnpr maintenance commands. Minor Changes pnpr now serves npm under /npm/ even when npm is the only ecosystem it serves. The npm registry URL is https:// /npm/ , and a named registry is at https:// /npm/~ / . articles.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer, the Inference Framework Behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
articles.summary: DeepSeek has open-sourced DeepInfer, the Apache 2.0 inference framework that serves DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash in production. It targets NVIDIA SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs, and ships offline inference only. articles.title: v8.0.0-rc.19
articles.summary: v8.0.0-rc.19 @default now means a database default, and values the client generates are written @onCreate(...) and @onUpdate(...) . Every default is stored in one form owned by its column's data type, so date, time and bytes defaults are written with tags. Clients take the contract as a typed value, can render any plan as SQL without a database, and run each ORM call as one activity that middleware and the cache can see. articles.title: pnpm 11.28.7
articles.summary: This release rejects registry metadata that names a different package than the one requested, applies trustPolicy to the pnpm version a project pins, and caps unpacked package size with maxTarballUnpackedSize . It also removes support for registry revisions, fixes verifyDepsBeforeRun after filtered installs, and finishes commands with their own exit code when a pipe reader exits early. Patch Changes Security pnpm now fails with ERR_PNPM_REGISTRY_NAME_MISMATCH if a registry returns metadata for a package other than the one requested. articles.title: pnpm 12.15
articles.summary: This release lets pnpm-workspace.yaml delegate settings to other files and config dependencies with include , adds lockfile.integrityTarget: tar and tar-registry support, accepts zstd-compressed registry responses, and honors SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH in pnpm deploy and pnpm install . It also rejects registry metadata that names a different package than the one requested and speeds up workspace installs and macOS file linking.
